prompt: Create an original 90 second melodic breakbeat electronica instrumental composition for puzzle game, strategy and patient problem solving. Mood: curious, playful, precise. Instruments: breakbeat drums, rounded bass, shimmering synth. Style: syncopated chopped drum rhythm under an evolving melody. Tempo approximately 136 BPM; C lydian. Main idea: alternating short and long phrases. Use offset accents and question-and-answer motifs without dramatic shocks. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:30] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:30-01:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:00-01:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:30.

description.en: A chill electronic track featuring a steady beat, evolving synth pads, and a melodic lead. The atmosphere is relaxed and slightly dreamy, with a consistent groove.
description.zh: 一首轻松的电子音乐，具有稳定的节拍、不断变化的合成器音垫和旋律主音。氛围轻松，略带梦幻感，节奏感始终如一。
